summary: Hangul composition incorrectly accepted LVT syllables with another trailing jamo, adding its offset and producing an unrelated syllable. The fix requires (l - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0, restricting composition to LV syllables. A verbatim implementation reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, and inspection of src/test.rs and its official normalization fixtures found no LVT-plus-trailing-jamo regression case. Leave this candidate blocked pending a suitable upstream test. No tests were executed.
